from pathlib import Path
from hashlib import sha256
from difflib import unified_diff
import json

placement = Path('products/distribution/catalogue-editor-example-placement')
live_path = placement / 'live-baseline.html'
checkout_path = Path('products/sites/shopify-catalogue-example/index.html')
live = live_path.read_bytes()
checkout = checkout_path.read_bytes()
diff = ''.join(unified_diff(live.decode('utf-8').splitlines(keepends=True), checkout.decode('utf-8').splitlines(keepends=True), fromfile=str(live_path), tofile=str(checkout_path)))
result = {'live_capture_sha256': sha256(live).hexdigest(), 'checkout_sha256': sha256(checkout).hexdigest(), 'equal_bytes': live == checkout, 'unified_diff': diff, 'scope': 'Saved live capture versus checkout supplied to this job. Release ownership, current live state and provenance of changes require separate evidence.'}
output = Path('products/distribution/catalogue-example-baseline-reconciliation/director-diff.json')
output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
output.write_text(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps({'artifact': str(output), 'equal_bytes': result['equal_bytes'], 'diff_hunks': sum(line.startswith('@@ ') for line in diff.splitlines())}))
